Common questions

Need a technician?

Call the service desk or WhatsApp us the details, with a photo of the unit's model sticker if you can.

Call nowWhatsApp us
Is Yamini Enterprises an authorised Hitachi dealer in Jodhpur?

Yes. Yamini Enterprises is the exclusive dealer and service provider for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur, and an authorised sale and service dealer for Hitachi air conditioners since 2009.

Which Hitachi AC works best in Jodhpur's summer heat?

Jodhpur summers regularly cross 45°C, so choose a model built for high outdoor temperatures. Hitachi's ductable ACs (Toushi and Takumi), concealed splits and Set Free Sigma VRF systems are listed to work up to 52°C, and the home split range uses Hitachi's Tropical or Expandable Inverter technology. Tell us where the outdoor unit will sit and we'll recommend the right model.

Where is your showroom?

Our Hitachi showroom is at 134, R.K. Nagar, Opp. B.R. Birla Public School, Jodhpur, Rajasthan 342008. Visit to compare Hitachi models side by side.

How do I book AC service or a repair?

Call +91 94141 00877 or send us the details on WhatsApp, with a photo of the unit's model sticker if you can. We handle installation, annual maintenance (AMC), gas refilling and repairs for Hitachi units.

Which AC capacity (tonnage) do I need?

It depends on room size, sun exposure, number of people and appliances. As a rough guide, small bedrooms often need about 1 ton and larger living rooms 1.5–2 tons, but we recommend talking to our team so we can size it correctly.

Inverter or fixed speed: which should I buy?

Inverter ACs adjust their speed to the cooling needed, so they use less electricity and keep the temperature steadier. They cost more upfront but usually save money if you run the AC for many hours a day. Fixed speed models suit lighter or occasional use.

Do you handle installation?

Yes. Our technicians handle installation, piping, drainage, electrical connections, testing and a demo.

What warranty do I get?

All products carry the Hitachi manufacturer's warranty, purchased through Yamini Enterprises as the exclusive dealer in Jodhpur. Ask us for the warranty terms of your model.

Which areas do you serve?

We primarily serve Jodhpur, and take on HVAC projects across Rajasthan.

Can you supply in bulk for projects or dealers?

Yes. Alongside individual customers, we handle large-scale projects for hotels, resorts, hospitals, commercial buildings, offices and industrial facilities. Contact us with your requirement for a quotation.
